newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lai Sun mulls convertible bonds for ATV.
newsitem.headline: Lai Sun mulls convertible bonds for ATV.

text.p: Lai Sun Development Co Ltd said on Monday the company is considering the possibility of issuing bonds exchangeable into shares of Asia Television Ltd (ATV) upon the possible listing of ATV shares in the future.
But the company said no definitive decision had been made in relation to the possible issue and whether such issue would be consummated would depend on various factors.
Further details regarding the possible issue would be announced at appropriate times if it is to proceed, the property developer and investor said.
The company also advised shareholders and investors to exercise caution in dealings in its shares, which dropped 20 cents to HK$11.80 in early Monday trade.
Lai Sun Development holds 16.67 percent of ATV. Both companies are controlled by the Lim family.
